selectCategory: Select a category from the sidebar.

getting-started.title: Getting Started
getting-started.description: Set up your account and learn the basics of Fumi.

composing.title: Composing
composing.description: Write and send emails with the rich text composer.

reading.title: Reading
reading.description: Read, organize, and act on your emails.

search.title: Search
search.description: Find emails quickly with powerful search operators.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Organize your emails with custom labels.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Navigate and act on emails without leaving the keyboard.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: View and manage your Google Calendar events.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Track to-dos extracted from emails or created manually.

ai-features.title: AI Features
ai-features.description: Use AI to summarize, reply, compose, and categorize emails.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Automate actions on incoming emails with filter rules.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Save reusable email templates for common replies.

security.title: Security
security.description: Stay safe with phishing detection and authentication checks.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Customize Fumi to fit your workflow.

gs-add-account.title: Add your email account
gs-add-account.description: Connect a Gmail or IMAP account to start using Fumi.
steps: Sign in with Google or enter your IMAP server details.
Fumi will sync your recent emails automatically.

gs-navigation.title: Navigate the interface
gs-navigation.description: The sidebar lists your folders and labels. Click a folder to view its threads. Select a thread to read it in the reading pane.

gs-theme.title: Switch themes
gs-theme.description: Toggle between light, dark, and system themes using the theme button at the bottom of the sidebar.

comp-new.title: Compose a new email
comp-new.description: Click the Compose button in the sidebar or press C to open a new message.

comp-reply.title: Reply and forward
comp-reply.description: Press R to reply, A to reply all, or F to forward the selected thread.

comp-schedule.title: Schedule send
comp-schedule.description: Choose a future date and time to send your email automatically.
steps: Click the clock icon next to the Send button.
Pick a date and time, then confirm.

comp-drafts.title: Auto-saved drafts
comp-drafts.description: Drafts are saved automatically every 3 seconds. If the app closes unexpectedly, you will be prompted to restore your draft on next launch.

read-thread.title: Thread view
read-thread.description: Emails are grouped into conversation threads. Open a thread to see all messages in order.

read-archive.title: Archive and trash
read-archive.description: Press E to archive or # to trash the selected thread. Trashing a thread already in Trash deletes it permanently.

read-snooze.title: Snooze emails
read-snooze.description: Snooze a thread to temporarily remove it from your inbox. It will reappear at the time you choose.

read-star.title: Star and pin
read-star.description: Press S to star or P to pin a thread for quick access later.

search-basic.title: Basic search
search-basic.description: Press / or Ctrl+K to open the command palette. Type any keyword to search across all your emails.

search-operators.title: Search operators
search-operators.description: Use Gmail-style operators for precise results: from:, to:, subject:, has:attachment, is:unread, before:, after:, label:.

search-smart-folders.title: Smart folders
search-smart-folders.description: Save frequently used searches as smart folders for one-click access from the sidebar.

label-create.title: Create a label
label-create.description: Click the + icon in the Labels section of the sidebar, or right-click an existing label to edit or delete it.

label-apply.title: Apply labels to threads
label-apply.description: Press V to move a thread to a folder or label. You can also drag and drop threads onto sidebar labels.

label-colors.title: Label colors
label-colors.description: Assign a color to each label so you can spot categories at a glance in the thread list.

sc-navigation.title: Navigation shortcuts
sc-navigation.description: J/K to move between threads, O or Enter to open, Escape to go back. G then I for Inbox, G then S for Starred, and more.

sc-actions.title: Action shortcuts
sc-actions.description: E to archive, S to star, # to trash, R to reply, A to reply all, F to forward, C to compose.

sc-customize.title: Customize shortcuts
sc-customize.description: Remap any keyboard shortcut in Settings to match your preferred workflow.

cal-view.title: Calendar views
cal-view.description: Switch between day, week, and month views. Navigate forward and backward with the toolbar buttons.

cal-create.title: Create events
cal-create.description: Click on an empty time slot or use the create button to add a new calendar event.

task-create.title: Create tasks
task-create.description: Add tasks manually from the Tasks page, or press T on a thread to extract tasks with AI.

task-filters.title: Filter tasks
task-filters.description: View all tasks, today's tasks, upcoming tasks, or completed tasks using the filter tabs.

task-recurring.title: Recurring tasks
task-recurring.description: Set a recurrence rule (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) and Fumi will create the next occurrence automatically when you complete one.

ai-summary.title: Thread summaries
ai-summary.description: Get a quick AI-generated summary of long email threads so you can catch up in seconds.

ai-reply.title: Smart replies
ai-reply.description: AI suggests short reply options based on the thread context. Click one to insert it into the composer.

ai-compose.title: AI compose and rewrite
ai-compose.description: Let AI draft an email from a prompt, or transform selected text (shorten, expand, fix grammar, change tone).

ai-categorize.title: Auto-categorization
ai-categorize.description: Fumi sorts incoming mail into Primary, Updates, Promotions, Social, and Newsletters using AI and rule-based heuristics.

filter-create.title: Create a filter
filter-create.description: Go to Settings and open Filters. Define criteria (sender, subject, keywords) and choose actions (label, archive, star, mark read, trash).

filter-logic.title: How filters work
filter-logic.description: Filter criteria use AND logic: all conditions must match. When multiple filters match the same message, their actions are merged.

tpl-create.title: Create a template
tpl-create.description: Open Settings, go to Templates, and add a new template with a name, subject, and body.

tpl-use.title: Use a template
tpl-use.description: In the composer, click the template picker to insert a saved template. You can also assign a keyboard shortcut to each template.

sec-phishing.title: Phishing detection
sec-phishing.description: Fumi scans links in emails for suspicious patterns (IP URLs, homograph attacks, URL shorteners, brand impersonation) and warns you before you click.

sec-auth.title: Authentication results
sec-auth.description: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC results are parsed from email headers and shown as a badge on each message so you can verify sender authenticity.

sec-images.title: Remote image blocking
sec-images.description: Remote images are blocked by default to protect your privacy. Allow images from trusted senders via the allowlist.

set-accounts.title: Manage accounts
set-accounts.description: Add or remove email accounts, configure OAuth client IDs, and manage send-as aliases.

set-appearance.title: Appearance
set-appearance.description: Choose a color theme, adjust font scale, change email density, and toggle the reading pane position.

set-ai.title: AI provider settings
set-ai.description: Configure API keys for Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini. Select which provider to use for each AI feature.

set-notifications.title: Notifications
set-notifications.description: Enable desktop notifications and add VIP senders to get notified only for the emails that matter.
